PermutationGroupRequest.description: A finite permutation group given by generator permutations on {0,...,n-1}.
PermutationGroupRequest.title: PermutationGroupRequest

input_schema.description:
Request the orbit of a point under a permutation group.

The group is the canonical permutation-group value, so a stabilizer
result's ``stabilizer`` subgroup feeds the advertised orbit consumer
unchanged instead of being unpacked into parallel top-level fields.

group.description: Permutation group acting on {0,...,degree-1} as the canonical value; pass a previous stabilizer or order request's group value unchanged.

input_schema.title: GroupOrbitRequest

output_schema.description: The orbit of a point under a permutation group.
output_schema.title: GroupOrbitResult

mathematical_scope: Finite sanity check of the one-face F3 Heisenberg action from the first manuscript's edge product. Index (x,y,z) by 9x+3y+z; generators are left multiplication by (1,0,0) and (0,1,0). This does not certify the universal support or separation theorem.
